body.statement: Define an internal one-off-target structural class by a finite latent response type \(U=(x_{\mathcal Z},y_{\mathcal T},r_{c,\mathcal Z})\), independent randomized assignment \(Z\), common target responses \(Y_t=y_t(U)\), exposure responses \(X_z=x_z(U)\), and arm-specific off-target responses \(R_{c,z}=r_{c,z}(U)\). This structural class and the full response-type class with \(\mathcal C=\{c\}\) induce exactly the same laws of \((X_{\mathcal Z},Y_{\mathcal T},R_{c,\mathcal Z})\), hence preserve the observed arm law \(p\) and \(\operatorname{law}(Y_{\mathcal T})\). The same response types also admit an internal fine-version representation with fine labels \((c,z)\) coarsened to \(c\). No equivalence with a published NPSEM class is asserted.
body.proof_tex:
The forward map simply records the internally defined coordinates
\[
(X_{\mathcal Z},Y_{\mathcal T},R_{c,\mathcal Z})
=(x_{\mathcal Z}(U),y_{\mathcal T}(U),r_{c,\mathcal Z}(U)).
\]
Because \(Z\) is independent of \(U\), it is independent of this finite response vector. Setting \(X=X_Z\) and using \(Y_t\) on target branches and \(R_{c,Z}\) on the off-target branch gives the incidence identities
\[
P(X=t,Y=y\mid Z=z)=P(X_z=t,Y_t=y),\qquad
P(X=c,Y=y\mid Z=z)=P(X_z=c,R_{c,z}=y),
\]
so the observed arm law and the complete target law are determined by the recorded response-type law.

Conversely, given any probability law on the full response-type space with \(\mathcal C=\{c\}\), take the full response type itself as \(U\), take auxiliary errors to be degenerate, and draw \(Z\) independently with the stated positive arm probabilities. The displayed structural equations then reproduce every response coordinate exactly.

For the internal fine-version representation, use the finite support
\[
\mathcal X^*=\mathcal T\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{(c,z):z\in\mathcal Z\},
\]
coarsen each \(t\) to itself and every \((c,z)\) to \(c\), and, on an off-target branch in arm \(z\), select fine version \((c,z)\) with outcome \(r_{c,z}(U)\). This again reproduces the same response vector coordinatewise. Thus the two internally defined representations have identical response-law fibers and target-law images. The construction is self-contained and makes no claim about the scope of any cited published model.
